stories.title: What Kyle Busch's death exposed about NASCAR's culture of toughness
stories.summary: Kyle Busch embodied NASCAR toughness. His death forced a look at what that means.

stories.title: Sources: Texans' Higgins tears ACL, out for season
stories.summary: Texans second-year wideout Jayden Higgins will miss the season after suffering a torn ACL during a joint practice with the Raiders, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: McIlroy questions value of LIV players to PGA
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy offered different opinions Wednesday on whether LIV Golf players potentially returning to the PGA Tour would bring value.

stories.title: Source: Seahawks to sign ex-Cowboys CB Diggs
stories.summary: Former Cowboys Pro Bowl cornerback Trevon Diggs plans to sign a one-year deal with the Seattle Seahawks, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Wednesday.

stories.title: McCarthy to hand reins to Howard, Allar vs. Jets
stories.summary: The Steelers will start second-year quarterback Will Howard against the Jets on Friday while 2026 fourth-round pick Drew Allar will follow.
